name: devtrack
description: DevTrack task manager: convenience scripts for the backend/ and client/ workspaces

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,white "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix client
